scope.description: Independent review of the frozen r2 four-workflow static/local probe packet, exact-archive fresh Mock runtime and restore packet, local fulfillment fixture, and exact-archive application-only Docker packet.

sourceAndCleanRepository.notes: Every archive member was independently read through .NET ZipArchive and checked against manifest size/hash. All 399 runtime files match the clean-history repository. All 458 exported source files match current source with the declared customer package.json command transformation.

workflows.review: Four presentation patches, manifests, protected snapshots, negative controls, rollback records and viewport observations were inspected. Protected snapshots retain the same 416 files for every workflow. The source freeze and modified-candidate digests agree with the packet. Negative engineering-classification checks were independently reproduced. All 79 command outputs exist and match expected exit results. All four retained mobile screenshots were visually inspected.

runtime.decision: PASS for retained local Mock-runtime evidence
runtime.review: Fresh offline install/build, eight exported buyer checks, migrations, authenticated HTTP journeys, private video bytes, cancellation, induced deadline recovery, queued dispatch restore and restart evidence agree. The final projection and ledger both show available=80, reserved=0, consumed=20, with four reservations and one submission attempt for each successful task. Restore evidence is identical in standalone restore.json and the parent result, covering 51 tables and two asset-root files.

fulfillment.review: Independently reran the narrow verifyLocalFulfillment function against the exact r2 archive. All eleven checks passed and the returned record exactly matches the retained packet. Temporary customer-copy rehearsal files were cleaned by the verifier. No merchant charge or external delivery occurred.

docker.review: Inspected the evidence-only Docker runner, build logs, HTTP observations, restart and cleanup records. The retained image ID matches local docker image inspect. Four public/page routes, two exact brand assets and fourteen nonempty CSS/JavaScript resources returned 200. Database readiness is a SELECT 1 check only. No host mounts or worker are involved.

scopeLimitations: PASS applies only to these local evidence packets. No M7 gate, M8 RC/BETA/STABLE gate, release export, deployment or customer delivery is approved.
Trusted preparation is running separately. Its actual record, output references and candidate identities have not been reviewed in this artifact; no candidateReview was added to the pin.

Workflow viewports use static React markup and CSS with no hydration or routed authenticated browser/checkout proof. Local database probes supplement those static views; the workflow evidence does not prove end-to-end browser interactions.
Fresh runtime uses Mock generation and local storage/mail. Deadline failure is induced by expiring a fixture task. Real provider, external email and payment behavior are not established.

The Docker packet proves the exact-archive application image, public routes, static resources, SELECT 1 readiness and restart only. Its production NODE_ENV and health profile do not establish production deployment, managed-profile acceptance, worker/storage/mail integration or SC-OPS-13 production closure.

The first Docker attempt failed because network=none prevented Corepack fetching pnpm. That failed packet is retained separately; its historical imageRetainedAsEvidence=true field is explained as unconditional bookkeeping. The successful retry used ordinary build networking with pull=false. No offline Docker build claim is accepted.

Fulfillment is a local mock order/entitlement and byte-copy rehearsal. Merchant eligibility, real orders, external delivery, commercial terms and acquired-version legal rights remain outside this review.

The retained runtime and Docker executions were reviewed rather than rerun. Independent execution in this review was limited to archive/source integrity checks, manifest classification probes, narrow fulfillment verification, and read-only Git/Docker inspection.
